minutes.headline: Planning Board found a nail salon addition at 383 Whalum Road de minimis and approved a covered asphalt pile at 1263 Reservoir Road.
minutes.summary: The board approved a de minimis site plan change for a nail salon at 383 Whalum Road, then held a hearing on a fabric-covered recycled asphalt structure for PJ Keating at 1263 Reservoir Road, granting waivers and approving the site plan with standard conditions. Board discussions covered the master plan website and model, solar canopy, driveway and aquifer protection bylaw drafts ahead of a September 18 warrant close, and committee reports. Minutes of 8/14/23 were approved with one abstention.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to treat a change at 383 Whalum Road as de minimis and accepted it, with no site plan hearing needed.
After a public hearing with no comment, the board granted waivers, closed the hearing and approved the site plan for a covered recycled asphalt pile at 1263 Reservoir Road.
The approval carries standard industrial construction hours and standard conditions; the applicant may pull a building permit at its own risk before the decision is signed.
The board backed a separate master plan website by consensus, and agreed without a vote to take over the farm-size zoning bylaw update.
Drafts of the solar canopy, driveways and entrances, and aquifer protection bylaws were not ready for a vote; the aquifer draft goes back for rework.

why_it_matters: Bylaw drafts that miss the warrant deadline wait until spring town meeting, so residents may not be asked to vote on solar, driveway or aquifer protection rules this fall.
The Reservoir Road approval is not final until the decision is signed and a 20-day appeal period runs, which is the window for neighbors who want to challenge it.
watch_next: The September 11 Planning Board meeting, where the solar bylaw updates are to be reviewed and the Reservoir Road decision signed, ahead of the September 18 warrant close.
The red-line of the farm-size zoning bylaw update, due at the next meeting.
